title: Closing questions about the Raeburn period
summary: Schremp asks what Handy would add; he thinks the Raeburn period is covered.

story.theme_name: Thanks and goodbyes: closing the interview
story.community_name: Closing the interview: thanks, goodbyes and tape running out

blocks.x: This afternoon, we unpeeled a lot of stuff I guess you hadn't thought about for a long time--

--and a lot of people and it all turned out to be terribly upbeat, I guess, now tell me the things you'd like to say. You've answered the questions beautifully, but there are many things I don't know to ask or don't know enough to ask; what would you have liked for me to have asked, what would you like to put on these tapes that we haven't gotten around to?
mostly is the period of my life which was involved with the Raeburn episode and I think we've covered everything.

We've spoken about Boyd; we spent time with the people that made up his bands, the guys that came in and out of it. They were all important; I mentioned the fact that some weren't as good musicians, but that doesn't make them any the less great for what they did, it was their contribution to the band.
Is there a question you wish I'd ask that I forgot to?
I can't think of anything, Bill. What else would you have been interested in?
Then we can shut this bloody thing off.
We're opening up the forum again.
You just remembered the job in New Jersey.
